name: SparkVerticalAxis
description: Represents the settings for the vertical axes of a group of sparklines.
remarks: Use the Vertical property of the SparkAxes object to return the SparkVerticalAxis object for group of sparklines.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent SparklineGroup object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: MinScaleType
properties.description: Returns or sets how the minimum value of the vertical axis of the sparkline is scaled relative to other sparklines in the group. Read/write.

properties.name: CustomMinScaleValue
properties.description: Returns or sets the custom minimum value for the vertical axis of a sparkline. Read/write.

properties.name: MaxScaleType
properties.description: Returns or sets how the maximum value of the vertical axis of the sparkline is scaled relative to other sparklines in the group. Read/write.

properties.name: CustomMaxScaleValue
properties.description: Returns or sets the custom maximum value for the vertical axis of a sparkline. Read/write.
